integrity: The proof is analytic. A bundled deterministic checker provides finite Pauli-channel consistency tests but is not used as a substitute for the infinite statement.
limitations: The exact positive privacy–concurrence curve is established only for unital qubit CPTP channels under pure QLDP. Nonunital channels, higher dimensions, and delta-positive privacy are not covered. Originality remains subject to the possibility of differently phrased prior channel-resource results not found in targeted searches.
title: Exact privacy–Choi-concurrence tradeoff for unital qubit channels
